answer.headline: Lead data scientist with eight years in online grocery and credit risk, focused on demand forecasting at scale, price experiments and statistics

experiences.title: Lead Data Scientist
experiences.summary: Owns a daily-retrained demand forecasting system for 15,000 products at an online grocer, built on Python and PySpark on Databricks, including a deep learning model for promotion weeks. Designs price experiments with the commercial team, maintains the team's SQL models and mentors three data scientists.

evidence.quote: Lead Data Scientist, Kurv.dk A/S (online grocery)
Own the demand forecasting system for 15,000 products, retrained daily and in production since 2022; it cut forecast error by 22%.
Built the forecasting pipeline in Python and PySpark on Databricks, processing 2 billion order lines.
Added a deep learning model (a temporal fusion transformer in PyTorch) for promotion weeks, which beat our gradient boosting model on fresh produce.
Design price experiments with the commercial team, from power analysis and sample size to the readout for category managers.
Write and review the team's SQL models, and tuned the slowest warehouse queries from hours to minutes.
Mentor three data scientists.

experiences.title: Data Scientist
experiences.summary: Built and validated credit risk models with scikit-learn and statsmodels, and presented them to the risk committee with documentation for non-technical readers.
